en: Grok follows task permissions, with file editing and task handoff available in project-editing and full-access modes.
Grok can view attached screenshots and images through its native image-reading tools.
A permanent Check for updates entry shows the installed version, available version, and release notes before you decide to download.
Updates now follow published stable releases. Checking never downloads, installs, or restarts the app automatically.
zh: Grok 支持修改文件和接续任务，遵循任务选择的只读、项目内编辑或完全访问权限。
Grok 支持查看随消息添加的截图和图片。
侧栏常驻“检查更新”，先展示当前版本、新版本和更新内容，再由你决定是否下载。
更新只跟随正式稳定版本；自动检查不会自行下载、安装或重启软件。
